goal._comment: Operator-provided goal for the supervisor to execute

active_tasks._comment: Record<string, ActiveTask> — tasks currently being executed by workers, keyed by task_id. Each entry contains { task, worker_id, started_at, worktree_path? }

file_locks._comment: Record<string, FileLock> — active file locks for parallel execution, keyed by file_path

completed_tasks._comment: List of tasks that have been completed. Includes 'intent', 'summary', and 'requires_context' for context tracking.

blocked_tasks._comment: List of tasks that are blocked and cannot proceed

decisions._comment: Record of decisions made during execution

active_sessions._comment: Persistent sessions for AI providers (Gemini, Copilot, etc.)

last_updated._comment: Timestamp of the last state update

execution_mode._comment: Execution mode, must default to AUTO
